**Goodtime Absence Policy**

**Private tuition**
If more than 24hrs notice is given to us in writing (text or email) before you or your child's scheduled lesson than a catch up lesson will be provided.  This catch up lesson will be organised directly with the tutor at a mutually suitable time.  We will provide up to 2 catch up lessons per term for explained absences (more than 24hrs notice).
If less than 24hrs notice is given, this lesson will be forfeited.
This policy is part of our terms and conditions that were agreed to when you registered, if you would like to re-read these t's and c's, we do have a copy that can be accessed online through our website.

**Schools programme tuition**
We do not provide individual catch up lessons for music bus students as these are group lessons at a low rate.  If a student is not able to be collected from class e.g. due to sickness or other school activities, then this lesson is considered forfeited.  We endeavour to work with the school to ensure that there are not scheduling conflicts with other activities, however sometimes this is inevitable and unforeseeable.  This policy is the reason why we can provide these lessons at 1/3 of what normal musical tuition costs and as such the margin would be untenable if we were constantly crediting lessons.  However in the odd occasion that one of our tutors is sick or unable to provide the lessons, we will at this point provide an alternate day for group lessons.

We thank you for your consideration of these policies and we can assure you, we have tried working out the problem of absences many ways and have found this to be the best for both parties. We do understand that with kids things do often pop up last minute that can't be helped, but we also understand that our tutors are working on the expectation of certain hours and income and it is unfair for them to have this continually changing last minute.  Therefore a line had to be drawn so everyone knew what to expect, for us that line is drawn at 24hrs notice.
